# Dr. Antounios Ashraf Platform - EduSaaS

> Official multi-tenant American High School Platform for Dr. Antounios Ashraf, designed for SAT, EST, and ACT test preparation, structured group learning, and academic tracking.

## Overview
- Platform Name: Dr. Antounios Ashraf Platform (منصة د. أنطونيوس أشرف)
- Domain: antounios.edsentre.com
- Purpose: American Curriculum preparation (SAT / EST / ACT), automated quizzes, timed exams, video lectures, and student performance metrics.
- Primary Language: Arabic (RTL) with English (LTR) American diploma terminology.
- Technology Stack: Flutter Web (CanvasKit / Wasm), Supabase PostgreSQL, Row Level Security (RLS), Cloudflare Pages.

## Key Portals
- Teacher Portal: `/teacher` - Management of student groups, academic content, assignments, attendance, and exam grades.
- Student Portal: `/student` - Access to assigned study groups, interactive practice, video materials, and results.
- Parent Portal: `/parent` - Real-time monitoring of attendance, exam scores, and student domain mastery.

## Standards & Security
- Isolation: Multi-Tenant database isolation enforced strictly via PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS).
- Integrity: Immutable historical academic snapshots for exams and submissions.
- Performance: WebAssembly-ready client runtime with responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
